verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core Bases plugin shows that notes carry properties that can be viewed, edited, sorted, filtered and grouped. A hands-on user report confirms property-based overviews such as NPC name, race and class. However, nothing in the evidence documents typed property values or tags. Missing for 10: documentation of typed properties (property types), any evidence of tag support, and evidence of tag- or property-based search and retrieval beyond Bases views.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can attach typed properties and tags to notes and use them consistently for organization and retrieval

citations.quote: Using a base you can view, edit, sort, and filter files and their properties.
Kanban - Display files as cards organized into columns based on a grouped property.
it made getting an overview of NPCs (name, pronouns, picture, race, class) much easier.
